WITH fv AS (
  SELECT member_id, join_date, home_store_id, valid_from,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from, member_key) AS vn,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY member_id) AS nver
  FROM dim_member)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, count(*) AS rows_, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS members,
       sum(CASE WHEN fv.valid_from <> fv.join_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS vf_ne_join,
       min(join_date), max(join_date),
       sum(CASE WHEN home_store_id>=900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS online_or_test
FROM fv JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = fv.join_date
WHERE vn=1 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25','FY2025/26','FY2026/27')
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH fv AS (
  SELECT member_id, join_date, home_store_id,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from, member_key) AS vn
  FROM dim_member)
SELECT fv.home_store_id, cs.store_name, cs.city, cs.region, cs.format, cs.open_date, cs.close_date, COUNT(*) AS new_members,
       min(join_date) AS first_join, max(join_date) AS last_join
FROM fv JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = fv.join_date
LEFT JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = fv.home_store_id AND cs.is_current
WHERE vn=1 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1

calls.statement:
SELECT count(*) AS rows_, count(DISTINCT member_key) AS keys, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS ids,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(DISTINCT join_date)>1)) AS ids_multi_join,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member GROUP BY 1 HAVING sum(CASE WHEN valid_to=DATE '9999-12-31' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)<>1)) AS ids_bad_current,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT member_id, home_store_id FROM dim_member GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)) AS dup_same_store,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member m LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id=m.home_store_id AND s.is_current WHERE s.store_id IS NULL) AS orphan_store,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member WHERE join_date>DATE '2026-10-04' OR join_date IS NULL)) AS bad_dates
FROM dim_member
